about: Blood Rites with answer rules and rules for the cards the demons engine rules starved, written from ab-run #29's 200 tables of bots (seed 20261290).

playbook.notes: Clavileno makes an attacking Vampire a Demon that draws a card and leaves a 4/3 flier when it dies, so the deck is Vampires that attack every turn with drain and lifegain on top. Stock Forge plays it fairly well in goldfish (12.4 turns, 12 of 12 kills) and leaves 43% of its mana unspent, but most of that is answers it rightly holds against do-nothing opponents. What it does leave undone: the commander late behind rocks it has (Sol Ring and Talisman out, Clavileno on turn 5 and Elenda held for four turns in game 7), anthems and engine permanents held (Kindred Boon, Glass-Cast Heart, Elenda's Hierophant held for many turns), Viscera Seer never cast (flagged), March of the Canonized barely cast. The rules: rocks, then the commander, then the anthems and engine permanents in order of worth, Champion of Dusk only with three Vampires and a library and life to pay for it, then the bodies; March of the Canonized for all the mana at X 3 or more; Viscera Seer is cast as a 1-mana Vampire but its scry outlet stays shut (Forge would feed it creatures); Glass-Cast Heart makes a lifelink Vampire with mana left after combat. Trigger rules take Bloodghast, Heirloom Blade, Bloodline Necromancer and Timothar always and Crossway Troublemakers' card while life and library allow. Answers (Swords, Utter End, Return to Dust, New Blood, Damn, Austere Command, Olivia's Wrath, Patron of the Vein, Butcher of Malakir's sacrifice, Vona's ability) are left to Forge in this pass. Go-wide attack, highest life first. Rule 9 equips Blade of the Bloodchief and Heirloom Blade before combat where Forge's own logic agrees on a carrier (it declined most offers in tuning); the last trigger rule takes Promise of Aclazotz's end-step populate once there is a token to copy and four creatures. Tuning on the audit seeds: 0.9 turns faster than stock (12 seeds), the last two additions neutral. || Version 2 (answers, 2026-11-14), written from the 200 tables of ab-run #29 (seed 20261290, stock and demons arms). Engine rules starved the answers and threats no rule named (Damn 12/37 cast against stock's 29/33, Austere Command 6/37 against 32/45, Olivia's Wrath 15/45 against 33/43, Patron of the Vein 22/45 against 43/47). New rules, in order, after the rocks and the commander: (3) Olivia's Wrath with three Vampires and an opponent with three creatures: every creature in this deck is a Vampire, so it is a one-sided wipe; stock cast it in 33 games, killing 1 to 115 opposing permanents and none of ours, and won 19. (4) a forge rule when an opponent has more power than we do and three creatures: Forge's own pick among the unnamed, which is where Austere Command goes (a play rule cannot choose its modes); stock's 32 Austere Commands destroyed about 13 opposing permanents to 2 of ours on average and the seat won 18 of those games. (5) Patron of the Vein while an opponent has a creature (its ETB removal, aimed by Forge). (6) Damn, single-target, cast when Forge's own logic finds a target worth it (a play rule never overloads; stock never overloaded it either, 29 of 29 targeted: Avenger of Zendikar, Hornet Queen, Krenko, Caesar...). Then the base's engine rule; (8) Sorin, Lord of Innistrad, Heirloom Blade and Swiftfoot Boots, starved by the body list; (9) a forge rule with no condition before Champion of Dusk and the bodies, so Austere Command, the instant removal, Village Rites and the activations no rule names get Forge's judgement before the filler creatures and the mana sinks. Base changes: Butcher of Malakir moved to the front of the body list (35/56 stock against 23/52; seven mana is the deck's finisher with Clavileno's dying Demons), Nighthawk Scavenger moved ahead of Bloodtracker; Patron of the Vein also listed after the bodies with no condition. New Blood (Forge's logic never casts it, 0 of 91 games drawn in both arms) and Pact of the Serpent (AI:RemoveDeck:All, a targeted player) are left as they were.
